items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Nat Dominique and Charlie Alexander was playing at Kelley's Stables in Chicago, and Dodds knew I were kind of hard up and he laid off one night and had me to go in his place, play in his place.

ctx.x: Nat Dominique and Charlie Alexander was playing at Kelley's Stables in Chicago, and Dodds knew I were kind of hard up and he laid off one night and had me to go in his place, play in his place. So that night -- so the job didn't pay but about two or three dollars a night, but the tips were so great.
